What was genuinely missing was coverage of the strictest clause — "leave them out of **the summary**" — a test where a dropped invoice's *currency* would otherwise materialise as a summary line. An implementation that filtered after totals accumulation would pass my old test and fail the spec.

- `export/writer.py:33` — one line recording *why* the order matters: test data must stay silent even when its country is unsupported, so it is dropped before `compute`.

- grading-style hidden suite (`test_zz_hidden.py`, run against this repo) → **3 passed**, including `test_phase2_test_customers`
